**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/06/16 (Fri) 20:24
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in getting a new gaming mouse to pair with their new keyboard.
- [PREFERENCE] User plays a lot of Apex Legends and is determined to reach level 100 before the end of the year.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended the following gaming mice for FPS games like Apex Legends: Logitech G Pro X Superlight, SteelSeries Rival 600, Razer DeathAdder Elite, HyperX Pulsefire Raid, and Corsair Harpoon Wireless.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering the SteelSeries Rival 600 and wants to know more about the TrueMove3 sensor.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided details about the TrueMove3 sensor, including its 1-to-1 tracking, no acceleration or deceleration, low latency, high precision at high speeds, and improved liftoff distance.
- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking of getting a new gaming headset to complete their setup.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended the following gaming headsets compatible with PC and good for games like Apex Legends: HyperX Cloud II, SteelSeries Arctis 7, Turtle Beach Recon 200, Logitech G Pro X, and Sennheiser GSP 670.
- [PREFERENCE] User is leaning towards the HyperX Cloud II but has heard that the surround sound can be inconsistent in some games.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant acknowledged the surround sound issue with the HyperX Cloud II and explained that it is not unique to this headset and provided context on its performance in Apex Legends.
- [PREFERENCE] User is still interested in the HyperX Cloud II due to its comfort and great microphone quality.
- [PREFERENCE] User inquired if the surround sound issue would be a dealbreaker for playing Apex Legends competitively.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant explained that the surround sound issue is not necessarily a dealbreaker for competitive play in Apex Legends, citing the game's audio design and the reliance on visual cues in competitive scenarios.
